### 2026-10-04 — Today I made a first draft. I asked my school for a bunch of different parts, and they loaned them to me until the parts on my list are funded, and I began soldering and putting in jumper wires for an

**7h**

Today I made a first draft. I asked my school for a bunch of different parts, and they loaned them to me until the parts on my list are funded, and I began soldering and putting in jumper wires for an audio player. I don't

![Screenshot 2026-10-04 at 10.04.45 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SPv1FZwZPr7z3ca5FSyaByS0lRXkH81L/3c46e174aadb42719b4b1a469263a4ebc33c3fd5a905bd826edec6114fd8b220.png)

 have an MP3 card reader, so I used the ESP32's Bluetooth capabilities to run music from my iPad, and I added clip art of a cat, volume bars, and a little text bar to show what's happening. I tried to theme it like Cyberpunk 2077, but I did not do a wonderful job, as I do not have a chassis. The final model, however, will be closer to solar punk. Thanks for reading.
